name: exchange_calendar
title: TADAWUL trading calendar (drives all window indexing)

fields.name: date
fields.description: Calendar date (ISO). The table must cover the full backtest span continuously.

fields.name: is_trading_day
fields.description: True if the exchange held a session. Captures the 2013 Thu-Fri→Fri-Sat weekend change and Eid/holiday closures implicitly.

fields.name: holiday_name
fields.description: Holiday label when closed; null on trading/normal days.

x-invariants: rolling 52-week / Perf windows and the backtest loop step over rows where is_trading_day = true
naive calendar-day arithmetic is forbidden; all bar indexing uses this table
